'''DeckTech''' (decktech.net) was a major SWCCG deck-list and tournament-report site in the late 1990s–2000s. The [[Players Committee]] later wrote that PC forums slowly overtook DeckTech, [[Game Players Network]], and other sites as the primary online hangout.<ref name="pc-net">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community-network/ Community Network], starwarsccg.org</ref>

Stephen Skilton's [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/ SWCCG Decktech Archives] keep 3,923 Star Wars deck posts (ids 3–26555, 11 August 1999 through 10 December 2002) and 1,406 tournament-report URLs. A GitHub Pages copy of the same dump is at [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/ stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives]. This wiki dests those posts onto [[DeckTech decks]] and [[DeckTech tournament reports]]; the Skilton hosts stay in Sources.

The same 3,923 posts are also hosted at [http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/ decktech.net]; individual posts are at `/starwarsccg/deck/{id}`. Title, author, handle, side, and rating letter indexes on that host 404. Listing Light/Dark tags on the archive index are often wrong (a Hunt Down post tagged Light).

Tournament reports name pairings, finishes, and sometimes include a 60. Dest those reports as articles and use them to fill event hubs and player Tournament Results.
